title.narrative: ISIOLO INTEGRATED FOOD SECURITY PROJECT PHASE II

description.narrative:
This project will directly target 240 pastoral and agro-pastoral households with a total population 1200 individuals (480 males and 720 females) in Isiolo County. The beneficiaries comprise rural pastoralists and agro-pastoralists drawn from 4 locations namely Kinna, Merti, Oldonyiro and Leparua. These areas are targeted primarily because of its high vulnerability to socio-economic crises manifested by livelihood and food insecurity, environmental degradation and malnutrition. In the past, it has noted that beneficiaries of such interventions end up sharing the inputs with other under privileged families with the context of the traditional social support mechanism, thereby increasing the number of direct and indirect beneficiaries. In this arrangement, this project is anticipated to reach up to 1,800 people. The target group includes highly vulnerable members including the disabled, elderly people, women headed households and people living with HIV/AIDS. The beneficiaries will be selected through an inclusive community-based targeting approach using vulnerability criteria. The following will be considered during the identification of the beneficiaries: • Access to social support networks- Priority will be given to households with no external social support. • Female headed households • Number of members in a household • Households caring for a disabled person • Households supporting elderly and/or infirm persons • Young orphan-headed households caring for siblings • Vulnerability to climate change
The targeting was arrived through needs assessment carried out involving community opinion leaders, government officers, religious leaders, nongovernmental organizations and community members. A needs assessment was carried out and it informed on the different needs for men women boys and girls on the following; conflict, livelihoods, health and nutrition, water, disaster risk reduction and governance status in the County. After analysis, the needs lying in the people of Isiolo County were prioritized as: food security, health and nutrition, environment conservation and water. Based on the analysis done, the project will focus its resources at women, children and youth. The rationale behind this is that women are the ones who are affected most and are vulnerable to shocks. Further, there will be an emphasis to identify female and child headed households, being groups in society that are often unattended to by communities. The youth have been targeted to support in establishment of livelihoods for future generations who have not been fully engaged in economic activities such as farming and trade in the region. The youth are also intended to provide linkages to markets due to their agile nature.
